query.commandtext: -- Create Date : 2019-07-12 19:12:59 DELETE FROM ?? WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :WAFER_SEQ
-- Create Date : 2019-07-17 11:25:23 SELECT 'BIN'||BIN BIN, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ?? WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq AND BIN < 100 GROUP BY BIN ORDER BY BIN

-- Create Date : 2019-07-31 16:44:39 SELECT DIE_NUM, ((X - :minX) + 1) AS "X", ((Y - :minY) + 1) AS "Y", DECODE(T2.BIN, NULL, T1.BIN, T2.BIN) AS "BIN", DECODE(T2.BIN_NAME, NULL, NULL, T2.BIN_NAME) AS "BIN_NAME", DECODE(T2.HIGH_GEC, NULL, NULL, T2.HIGH_GEC) AS "HIGH_GEC" FROM ?? T1, TQP_BINDESC T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.BIN = T2.BIN(+) AND T1.WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq AND T2.PROGRAM(+) = :program ORDER BY DIE_NUM

-- Create Date : 2019-07-31 16:48:24 SELECT DIE_NUM, X, Y DECODE(T2.BIN, NULL, T1.BIN, T2.BIN) AS "BIN", DECODE(T2.BIN_NAME, NULL, NULL, T2.BIN_NAME) AS "BIN_NAME", DECODE(T2.HIGH_GEC, NULL, NULL, T2.HIGH_GEC) AS "HIGH_GEC" FROM ( SELECT T1.DIE_NUM, BIN, ((X - :minX) + 1) AS "X", ((Y - :minY) + 1) AS "Y", FROM ?? T1, ?? T2 WHERE T1.WAFER_SEQ = T2.WAFER_SEQ AND T1.DIE_NUM = T2.DIE_NUM AND T1.WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq ) T1, TQP_BINDESC T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.BIN = T2.BIN(+) AND T2.PROGRAM(+) = :program ORDER BY T1.DIE_NUM

-- Create Date : 2019-08-13 19:36:24 SELECT TO_CHAR(T1.START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "LOT_START_TIME", TO_CHAR(T1.END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "LOT_END_TIME", TO_CHAR(T2.START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "WAFER_START_TIME", TO_CHAR(T2.END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "WAFER_END_TIME", T1.PROGRAM, T1.LOT_ID, T2.TESTER, T2.PROBE_CARD, T2.OPERATOR, A.WAFER_SEQ, T2.WAFER_ID, A.DIE_NUM, A.DIEPROBE_CNT, ?? FROM TQP_LOT T1, TQP_WAFER T2, ?? WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.LOT_SEQ = T2.LOT_SEQ AND T1.FACTORY = T2.FACTORY AND T2.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ ?? AND T1.FACTORY = :factory AND T1.LOT_SEQ IN (??) AND T2.WAFER_SEQ IN (??) ORDER BY LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, DIE_NUM

-- Create Date : 2019-08-13 19:37:17 SELECT T1.LOT_ID, T1.PROGRAM, T2.WAFER_ID, T1.START_TIME AS "LOT_START_TIME", T1.END_TIME AS "LOT_END_TIME", T2.START_TIME AS "WAFER_START_TIME", T2.END_TIME AS "WAFER_END_TIME", T2.TESTER, T2.PROBE_CARD, MAX (T3.LSL) AS "LSL", MAX (T3.TARGET) AS "TARGET", MAX (T3.USL) AS "USL", MAX (T3.LCL) AS "LCL", MAX (T3.UCL) AS "UCL", COUNT (??) AS "CNT", ROUND(MIN (??), 15) AS "MININUM", ROUND(PERCENTILE_DISC (.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ??), 15) Q1, ROUND(MEDIAN (??), 15) AS "MEDIAN", ROUND(PERCENTILE_DISC (.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ??), 15) Q3, ROUND(MAX (??), 15) AS "MAXINUM", ROUND(AVG (??), 15) AS "AVERAGE", ROUND(STDDEV (??), 15) AS "STDDEV" FROM TQP_LOT T1, TQP_WAFER T2, TQP_PARASPEC T3, ?? T4 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.LOT_SEQ = T2.LOT_SEQ AND T1.FACTORY = T2.FACTORY AND T2.WAFER_SEQ = T4.WAFER_SEQ -- AND T1.PROGRAM = T3.PROGRAM AND t2.PROGRAM = T3.PROGRAM AND t2.PROGRAM_REV = T3.PROGRAM_REV AND T1.FACTORY = :factory AND T3.PARAM_NAME = :param_name AND T1.LOT_SEQ IN (??) AND T2.WAFER_SEQ IN (??) AND DECODE(T3.TEST_LOW, NULL, '-10000000', T3.TEST_LOW) <= ?? AND DECODE(T3.TEST_HIGH, NULL, '10000000', T3.TEST_HIGH) >= ?? GROUP BY T1.LOT_ID, T1.PROGRAM, T2.WAFER_ID, T1.START_TIME, T1.END_TIME, T2.START_TIME, T2.END_TIME, T2.TESTER, T2.PROBE_CARD ORDER BY LOT_ID, WAFER_ID

-- Create Date : 2019-08-20 18:30:03 SELECT T1.LOT_ID, T1.PROGRAM, T2.WAFER_ID, T1.START_TIME AS "LOT_START_TIME", T1.END_TIME AS "LOT_END_TIME", T2.START_TIME AS "WAFER_START_TIME", T2.END_TIME AS "WAFER_END_TIME", T2.TESTER, T2.PROBE_CARD, T2.YIELD, ?? FROM TQP_LOT T1, TQP_WAFER_SUM T2, ?? WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.LOT_SEQ = T2.LOT_SEQ AND T1.FACTORY = T2.FACILITY AND ?? AND T1.FACTORY = :factory AND T1.LOT_SEQ IN (??) AND T2.WAFER_SEQ IN (??) ORDER BY 1, 3, 12

T4 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.LOT_SEQ = T2.LOT_SEQ AND T1.FACTORY = T2.FACILITY AND T2.WAFER_SEQ = T4.WAFER_SEQ -- AND T1.PROGRAM = T3.PROGRAM AND t2.PROGRAM = T3.PROGRAM AND T1.FACTORY = :factory AND T3.PARAM_NAME = :paramname AND T1.LOT_SEQ IN (??) GROUP BY T1.LOT_ID, T1.PROGRAM, T2.WAFER_ID, T1.START_TIME, T1.END_TIME, T2.START_TIME, T2.END_TIME, T2.TESTER, T2.PROBE_CARD ORDER BY T2.WAFER_ID
-- Create Date : 2019-08-24 11:23:23 SELECT MIN(X) MIN_X, MAX(X) MAX_X, MIN(Y) MIN_Y, MAX(Y) MAX_Y FROM ?? WHERE 1=1 AND WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq ORDER BY DIE_NUM
